# RobustnessViaFoveation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The property that foveation-guided token selection improves model robustness against input perturbations and distribution shifts by focusing on invariant, salient features. This is crucial for neuromorphic systems deployed in dynamic environments where input noise and variability are common, ensuring reliable in-network decision-making.
